operating_income.source: Operating income not reported by the tool (null). Proxy = pretax income (52,783/48,873/41,268) + interest expense (849/996/603), us-gaap tags, acc. 0000034088-26-000045. Reviewer should replace with filed figure.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 revenue fell 5% (332,238 vs 349,585); assume modest recovery near inflation with flat commodity prices and volume growth from Permian/Guyana offset by price normalisation.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at about FY2025 proxy margin 12.6% (41,871/332,238); below FY2023-24 (15.6%/14.3%) given weaker price environment.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: Damodaran US Oil/Gas (Integrated) effective tax rate 28.2% (betas dataset 2026-01-05).

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex 28,358 / revenue 332,238 = 8.5%; consistent with elevated investment programme

wacc.source: Assumption. CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.31 (Damodaran unlevered cash-corrected 0.278, D/E 0.138, tax 25%) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US) = CoE ~6.2%; blended WACC ~5.9%. Damodaran's integrated-oil beta looks too low for a cyclical commodity business, so 7.5% is used as a conservative judgement; reviewer should sensitise.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run inflation-like growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate; conservative for an oil major in energy transition.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 43,537 (LT 34,241 + current 9,296) - cash 10,681; no short-term investments; acc. 0000034088-26-000045. Note debt tags may include some finance leases.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted diluted shares not reported by the tool (null). Derived = net income 28,844M / diluted EPS 6.70 = ~4,305M (acc. 0000034088-26-000045); approximate. Cover shares outstanding 4,144.9M at 2026-03-31 (acc. 0000034088-26-000067).
